messages:
Asha (Finance): Quick postmortem follow-up: delayed ledger ingest caused token double-counts for a subset of customers. Need owners + short timelines for credits and invoice holds.

Dev (SRE): I'll put a temporary block on finalizing invoices that touch the suspect window. ETA: 2h.

Pri (Billing): I'll own the credits/reissues. need CSV of affected accounts + usd amounts. ETA after data handoff: 48h.

Ravi (DataEng): I'll run the diff between pre-incident snapshot and current ledger to compute token deltas. output CSV with columns [account_id, tokens_to_credit, usd_amount, needs_legal]. ETA: 24h.

Marta (CS): I'll prepare customer comms: ack now, detailed follow-up after we confirm amounts. want to review language with Billing.

OpsBot: Incident I-2026-04-02-03 logged. status: mitigation in progress.

Dev (SRE): hotfix deployed to prevent duplicate retries. monitoring shows no new duplicates in last 15m.

Asha (Finance): checkpoint timeline: 2h block (Dev), 24h CSV (Ravi), 36-72h billing ops (Pri). I'll schedule daily 10m check-ins until resolved.

Pri (Billing): note on process: prefer issuing credits where possible; reissue only if > $2k or contractual. will flag top impacts for Legal.

Ravi (DataEng): quick sample: initial run shows ~300k duplicated tokens across ~120 accounts; skewed to top accounts. will include histogram.

Marta (CS): comms draft posted: https://docs.internal/redwood/cs/credit-ack-04-02. please add comments.

Pri (Billing): created ticket BILL-9055 for workload and approvals. adding estimated exec steps.

Asha (Finance): reminder: attach deploy metadata if possible (deploy_sha) so PM/Eng can trace change.

Dev (SRE): will include deploy_sha in logs and add to Ravi's join.

Ravi (DataEng): CSV uploaded to secure bucket: s3://internal/incident_2387654321/credits.csv. shared with Billing+Finance.

Pri (Billing): validating CSV now. will prepare SAMPLE_PAYOUT.csv and post within 12h.

Asha (Finance): thanks team. we'll reconvene at the 24h checkpoint. escalate here if anything slips. :thumbsup:
